text: ポケモンが　２ひき　いるわよ！

patterns.name: 〜がいる (need)
patterns.span: ポケモンが　２ひき　いる
patterns.explanation: This いる is 要る 'to be needed', not 'to exist'; the needed thing takes が. ポケモンが　２ひき　いる = 'you need two Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ is a soft feminine ending, and with よ it becomes a firm announcement. いるわよ = 'you need them, you know!'.
